note: Identity-only capture for the JDAM, the Joint Direct Attack Munition guidance family. The entry names the family and no variant: it holds no figure, carries no alias and claims no member. The identity evidence is the engine class table and the corpus itself: the installed content displays 'GBU-31 JDAM 2000lb', 'GBU-32 JDAM 1000lb' and 'GBU-31 JDAM' on classes whose own text carries the JDAM designation, and the GBU-31 and GBU-38 entries each publish JDAM as a designation. The grade is claimed, because the evidence is identity text and not a held figure. No document citation is invented. The keyword holds the family designation the display names carry. A mark entry must not claim it: the family owns it, and the family rung alone reads it.
